fullPassage: Giving kids an edible treat that you know they love after a tricky day to cheer them up or soothe them can be tempting but I advise you not to. When we try to comfort a child with food rather than attend to their physical and emotional needs, we leave them feeling not understood. Instead of learning that they'll receive appropriate comfort and attention, they receive the message that their needs can't or won't be met appropriately. Consequently, they understand one of the following: that their needs are not valid; that they are too much for their parent; that they are being silly; that next time they should keep quiet; or that they need to shout louder to be heard. If, after tending to your child's emotional and physical wounds you want to offer some chocolate, ice cream or a trip to a fast-food restaurant, that is, of course, completely fine — but it must not replace the nurture.

When we try to (B)[comfort / neglect] a child with food rather than attend to their physical and emotional needs, we leave them feeling not understood. Consequently, they understand one of the following: that their needs are not valid; that they are too much for their parent; that they are being silly; that next time they should keep quiet; or that they need to shout louder to be heard. questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) tempting=유혹적인, (B) comfort=위로하다, (C) appropriate=적절한
det.analysis:
✅ ① tempting — comfort — appropriate: 원문 일치. 음식으로 달래는 것이 유혹적(tempting)이지만, 음식으로 위로(comfort)하려 하면 적절한(appropriate) 위안을 받을 수 없다는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
❌ ② repulsive — comfort — appropriate: (A) repulsive(혐오스러운)는 tempting(유혹적인)의 반의어로 부적절
❌ ③ tempting — neglect — appropriate: (B) neglect(방치하다)는 comfort(위로하다)의 반의어로 부적절
❌ ④ tempting — comfort — harmful: (C) harmful(해로운)은 appropriate(적절한)의 반의어 방향으로 부적절
det.tip: can be tempting(유혹적) / comfort a child(아이를 위로) / appropriate comfort(적절한 위안)

Consequently, they understand one of the following: that their needs are not (B)[valid / trivial]; that they are too much for their parent; that they are being silly; that next time they should keep quiet; or that they need to shout louder to be heard. questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) attend=돌보다, (B) valid=타당한, (C) tending=돌보다/보살피다
det.analysis:
❌ ① attend — trivial — tending: (B) trivial(사소한)은 valid(타당한)의 반의어로 부적절
❌ ② surrender — valid — tending: (A) surrender(항복하다)는 attend(돌보다)와 의미가 전혀 다름
✅ ③ attend — valid — tending: 원문 일치. 신체적·감정적 요구에 응하고(attend), 자신의 요구가 타당하지(valid) 않다고 느끼며, 아이의 상처를 돌본(tending) 후라는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
❌ ④ attend — valid — ignoring: (C) ignoring(무시하다)은 tending(돌보다)의 반의어로 부적절
det.tip: attend to their needs(요구에 응하다) / needs are not valid(요구가 타당하지 않다) / tending to wounds(상처를 돌보다)

questions.passage: Giving kids an edible treat that you know they love after a tricky day to cheer them up or (A)[soothe / agitate] them can be tempting but I advise you not to. When we try to comfort a child with food rather than attend to their physical and emotional needs, we leave them feeling not understood. Instead of learning that they'll receive appropriate comfort and attention, they receive the message that their needs can't or won't be met appropriately. (B)[Consequently / Nevertheless], they understand one of the following: that their needs are not valid; that they are too much for their parent; that they are being silly; that next time they should keep quiet; or that they need to shout louder to be heard. questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) soothe=달래다, (B) Consequently=결과적으로, (C) nurture=양육/보살핌
det.analysis:
❌ ① soothe — Consequently — indulgence: (C) indulgence(방종/탐닉)는 nurture(양육)와 의미가 다름. 음식 보상이 양육을 대체해서는 안 된다는 맥락에서 nurture가 적절
❌ ② agitate — Consequently — nurture: (A) agitate(동요시키다)는 soothe(달래다)의 반의어로 부적절
❌ ③ soothe — Nevertheless — nurture: (B) Nevertheless(그럼에도)는 역접이라 앞뒤 인과 관계와 맞지 않음. Consequently(결과적으로)가 적절
✅ ④ soothe — Consequently — nurture: 원문 일치. 아이를 달래고(soothe), 결과적으로(Consequently) 이해하게 되며, 음식이 양육(nurture)을 대체해선 안 된다는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
det.tip: soothe them(아이를 달래다) / Consequently, they understand(결과적으로 이해하다) / must not replace the nurture(양육을 대체 금지)

❌ ③ relevant: relevant(관련 있는)은 appropriate와 유사한 방향
✅ ④ improper: improper(부적절한)는 appropriate(적절한)의 정확한 반의어 ←정답
det.tip: appropriate(적절한) ↔ improper(부적절한)

questions.passage: Giving kids an edible treat that you know they love after a tricky day to cheer them up or soothe them can be tempting but I advise you not to. When we try to comfort a child with food rather than attend to their physical and emotional needs, we leave them feeling not understood. Instead of learning that they'll receive appropriate comfort and attention, they receive the message that their needs can't or won't be met appropriately. Consequently, they understand one of the following: that their needs are not valid; that they are too much for their parent; that they are being silly; that next time they should keep quiet; or that they need to shout louder to be heard. If, after tending to your child's emotional and physical wounds you want to offer some chocolate, ice cream or a trip to a fast-food restaurant, that is, of course, completely fine — but it must not replace the <u>nurture</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 nurture와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: nurture=양육/보살핌 ↔ neglect=방치/소홀
det.analysis:
❌ ① cultivation: cultivation(육성)은 nurture와 유사한 방향
❌ ② guidance: guidance(지도)는 nurture와 유사한 방향
✅ ③ neglect: neglect(방치/소홀)는 nurture(양육/보살핌)의 정확한 반의어 ←정답
❌ ④ support: support(지원)는 nurture와 유사한 방향
det.tip: nurture(양육/보살핌) ↔ neglect(방치/소홀)

questions.passage:
(A) After a tricky day, parents may <u>treat</u> their children to ice cream to cheer them up.
(B) The doctor will <u>treat</u> the patient's infection with a course of antibiotics.
questions.stem: 다음 (A)와 (B)의 밑줄 친 treat가 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: (A) treat=대접하다/한턱내다, (B) treat=치료하다
det.analysis:
❌ ① (A) 치료하다 — (B) 대접하다: (A)와 (B)의 의미가 뒤바뀜
✅ ② (A) 대접하다 — (B) 치료하다: (A)는 아이에게 아이스크림을 '사주다/대접하다', (B)는 감염을 항생제로 '치료하다' ←정답
❌ ③ (A) 다루다 — (B) 간주하다: treat의 다른 의미이지만 문맥에 맞지 않음
❌ ④ (A) 협상하다 — (B) 처리하다: treat에 '협상하다'의 의미는 없음
det.tip: (A) treat someone to = ~를 대접하다/사주다 vs (B) treat a disease = 질병을 치료하다

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "to take care of someone's needs by giving attention and support"

det.korean: nurture=양육하다/보살피다: 관심과 지원을 제공하여 누군가의 요구를 돌보는 것
det.analysis:
❌ ① neglect: neglect(방치하다)는 돌봄의 반대
❌ ② compete: compete(경쟁하다)는 돌봄과 무관
✅ ③ nurture: nurture(양육하다/보살피다)는 관심과 지원으로 돌보는 것이라는 영영 정의에 정확히 부합 ←정답
❌ ④ evaluate: evaluate(평가하다)는 돌봄이 아닌 판단
det.tip: nurture = to take care of someone's needs by giving attention and support
